title: Base Read Coils variant 4
purpose: Cover the Read Coils operation with a compact request using a non-default unit identifier, nonzero starting address, and moderate coil quantity.

messages.label: Read Coils request, unit 11, address 0x0010, quantity 0x0013

expected_behavior: A conforming server should parse the request as a Read Coils operation and return a response containing the requested coil status or a normal Modbus exception response if the addressed data is unavailable.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0006 equals one unit byte plus the five-byte Read Coils PDU.
Function code 01, starting address, and quantity fields are ordered consistently.
Quantity is within the ordinary Read Coils request range.
issue_safety_notes: No external issue knowledge or vulnerability report is available. This is a conservative model-prior-valid seed and is not intended to reproduce a known issue.
